notes.title: UPDATE on LP/Livestreams/YouTube
notes.notes: Hello, everyone! There seems to be a misunderstanding about our policy on showing the game on your channel. You don't need to register to do it. You have our permission to monetize the content, AND you always have. We just stopped giving out free codes for the time being.
